title: [Push Messages] Improve Recipients list UX

What remains is one High and several Medium defects found by the full UI operator matrix and the visual pass - none of them reported to the ticket yet - plus an accessibility FAIL and a vc-shell defect that is out of this ticket scope. findings.summary: In Advanced query mode the 'Query is valid' hint is unconditional, so a phrase that silently matches the whole member base is affirmed as valid
findings.provenance: SPLIT — root cause PRE-EXISTING, the affirmation IN-SCOPE
findings.evidence: emails:"a" -> 136 recipients / 240 matched / 63 companies expanded vs 129 for a deliberate membertype:Contact; identical figures for '(((' and '*:*' because all three collapse to the same empty filter set. ATTRIBUTION CORRECTED 2026-09-28: the match-all collapse is PRE-EXISTING platform parser behaviour, NOT introduced by PR #28 - vcst-qa (PushMessages 3.1005.0, ElasticSearch8Provider) returns 1321 for the same malformed inputs vs 1104 for a deliberate membertype:Contact. What IS new is the affirmation: the hint renders on v-if="rawQuery" with no validity check, and the old build had no preview endpoint at all (405). Mitigating: the count itself is shown truthfully, so an author who reads the number sees the real figure.

findings.summary: Six OR-joined clauses (the conditions builder's 'Match ANY' with six rows) make preview-recipients return HTTP 500, and the inline estimate panel presents it as an ordinary empty audience
findings.provenance: SPLIT — provider limit PRE-EXISTING, the surfacing IN-SCOPE
findings.evidence: TRIGGER CORRECTED 2026-09-28: it is CLAUSE COUNT, not query length. The previously recorded '419 chars -> 200, 420 -> 500' does NOT reproduce - every length 400..1024 returns 200, and a single 1000-char quoted value returns 200. Measured first-500 thresholds: OR-joined clauses at 6 (146 chars), space/AND-joined at 33, free-text terms at 59, comma multi-value (one clause) never up to 60. Confirmed live in the UI: 5 rows under ANY -> 200 with a real zero; 6 rows -> 500 {"message":"Response status code does not indicate success: 400 (Bad Request)."}. ATTRIBUTION: the 400 is an ElasticAppSearch provider limit and reproduces on the PRE-EXISTING /api/members/search endpoint too; vcst (ElasticSearch8) handles 20 OR clauses fine. IN-SCOPE half: the new conditions builder makes it reachable in six clicks, the new endpoint leaks it as a 500 with an internal message, the always-visible inline panel shows a normal-looking '0 recipients', and Save stays enabled. NOT silent everywhere: clicking 'Preview recipients' does show 'Could not load the recipients. Try again.' UI-STRING CORRECTION: 'Query is valid - 0 recipients' belongs to Advanced query mode only; conditions mode shows no such hint.

findings.summary: Reported silent truncation of memberQuery to 1024 does NOT reproduce; over the limit the API returns HTTP 500 leaking a raw SQL error
findings.provenance: PRE-EXISTING (API-only) — the reported defect did NOT reproduce
findings.evidence: DISPROVEN 2026-09-28 by direct API probe: 500 chars -> 200 stored 500; 1024 -> 200 stored 1024; 1025 -> HTTP 500; 1119 -> HTTP 500. No truncation at any length. The 500 body leaks schema: "String or binary data would be truncated in table 'vcptcore-qa1-platform_vcptcore.dbo.PushMessage', column 'MemberQuery'". The originally reported '1119 sent, 1024 stored, HTTP 200' is explained by the textarea's own maxlength="1024", i.e. normal browser input capping, not a server defect. Reachable only through the API since the UI caps input. Model and schema are untouched by PR #28, so this is pre-existing.

findings.evidence: Announces 'Resolved from the audience as it stands - 126 recipients.' then requests take:50 and renders rows 0-49. Index 49 is the last row, immediately followed by Close. This is the feature's own verification affordance.

findings.summary: An incomplete condition row is silently dropped and the count shows the WIDER audience
findings.evidence: Rows 'Customer type is Contact' + 'Name is <empty>' under ALL -> 126, i.e. the Contact-only audience. No 'Enter a value' prompt; the row still renders as an active AND-constraint. Error is always in the permissive direction.

declared_open_decisions.summary: startsWith/endsWith/contains emit a quoted wildcard only the ElasticSearch filter builder honours
declared_open_decisions.detail: The developer's note named ElasticSearch and Lucene. The deployed provider on this env is ElasticAppSearchProvider, which it never mentions, and all three operators resolve to 0 there. The 'Email domain' starter chip is built entirely on endsWith and returns 0 for a domain with ~30+ matching contacts - so the advertised happy path, not a power-user edge case. Offered unconditionally with no warning or disabled state.

declared_open_decisions.summary: 'Everyone' emits the fixed phrase membertype:Contact, excluding an Employee holding a login
declared_open_decisions.detail: The seeded Employee holds a working login, is reachable via membertype:Employee and received a real send, yet is absent from all 129 Everyone rows. No UI text discloses this; the label is an unqualified 'All registered customers'. Before the seeded fixture both numbers were 0 and the claim could not fail.

Q1_rejected_query.evidence: At 6 ANY rows the panel shows verbatim "Recipients can't be counted for this audience — the search index rejected the query. Check it in Show generated query."; the headline is an em dash, NOT 0; the Preview-recipients button is removed. preview-recipients observed 200 at 5 clauses / 500 at 6. Save proven INERT by clicking it: no POST/PUT /api/push-message fired, the blade kept "Has unsaved changes", the list count did not move. Method note: this component library never emits [disabled] (the definitionally-inert "Delete selected" button also lacks it), so the signal is the presence/absence of [cursor=pointer], A/B-tested by removing and re-adding the 6th row. Send was NOT clicked - its inertness is inferred from an identical rendered state, not observed.

Q2_false_valid.evidence: Advanced query, `emails:"a` -> literal hint "Query is valid — 136 recipients.", headline 136, breakdown 240 matched / 63 companies expanded / 135 in scope. Deliberate `membertype:Contact` -> "Query is valid — 129 recipients.", headline 129. So the malformed input is affirmatively declared valid AND reports MORE recipients than the well-formed one. The new estimateFailed guard keys off transport failure; this is a 200, so it does not fire.

The dialog table has NO total indicator at all - neither 50 nor 129 - while the Push Messages list table on the same screen does carry a "1–10 of 10" footer plus pagination. No paging, no "showing 50 of N", no load-more; scrolling to the bottom fired no further request and the DOM still held 50 rows.

open_findings.summary: The QA environment badge renders twice on an embedded app - once by the platform shell, once by the vc-shell framework inside the iframe
open_findings.evidence: vc-environment-banner lives in the framework bundle (push-messages vc-shell-framework56652.js, vc-sales-rep …49902.js), absent from vc-news and tasks which ship an older framework build. The vc-app root computes isEmbedded from EmbeddedMode=true and omits it from the render condition (!isIgnored && environmentName). Label derives from window.location.hostname, which is why prod is unaffected. Independently re-verified by walking 58/50 module imports per app.
open_findings.caveat: Read from the deployed minified bundle - {OBSERVED} on this stand, not from vc-shell source. Confirm against the matching tag before patching.

open_findings.evidence: Customer type and Status stay single-select under "is any of": a second pick REPLACES the first (Contact then Organization emits membertype:Organization, count 146 -> 68). The multi-value shape works at the API - status:Approved,New returns 137 vs 128 and 18 separately - so the operator is offered but the control cannot satisfy it. Role, Company and all free-text fields accumulate correctly. Secondary: the value renders as a raw JSON array literal [ "Contact" ].
